answer: An asset-based advisory fee is typically tied to the value of the assets held in your account with the adviser. The source does not specify a fee rate, so the amount you pay depends on the fee arrangement in your agreement. Advisory fees are not necessarily the only costs: you may also pay other fees and costs related to servicing the account and the investments you buy, sell, or hold.
